title: Run Manifest
description: Input manifest for the /run command. Declares a list of tasks to execute in sequence, each mapping to a specialist command and its arguments.

tasks.description: Ordered list of tasks to execute. Tasks are executed in declaration order unless dependency resolution reorders them.

type.description: Task type identifier. Must match a command name registered in this plugin.

args.description: Key-value arguments for the task. Keys correspond to the command's CLI argument names (without leading --). Values may use '{{ output }}' to reference the run's output root.

output_dir.description: Override the output subdirectory for this task. Defaults to './output/<task-type>/' relative to the run output root.

depends_on.description: List of prior task types whose output this task depends on. Used for explicit dependency ordering within the manifest.

output.description: Root output directory for the entire run. Defaults to './output/'. Individual tasks write into subdirectories of this root.

request_id.description: Optional caller-supplied identifier for this run. Echoed in the consolidated result manifest.
